name: [🐰] Hood Wars
desc:
BECOME A LEGEND OF THE HOOD in Hood Wars!!

Choose a class, jump into fast paced PvP, hit a lick to collect accessories, and sell them for cash. Outplay everyone and prove you run the streets.

CODES: Find codes in our social links!

This is a work of fiction. Any resemblance to actual persons, living or dead, or actual events is purely coincidental.

🎮CONTROLS:
Shoot - LCLICK [PC], R2 [CONSOLE]
Aim - RCLICK [PC], L2 [CONSOLE]
Reload - R [PC], X [CONSOLE]
Sneak - LSHIFT [PC], B [CONSOLE]
Mouse Lock - LCTRL [PC]
Emote - T [PC], DPadDown [CONSOLE]

💛LIKE, FAVORITE, and JOIN the group for REWARDS!
